from hermes_tools import write_file,terminal
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u047/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2b75c7cc.py'
s='''def transform(grid):
    # A solid divider separates two equal-width panels. The upper panel is the mask
    # of locations to retain; lower colors determine the background/output palette.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    # Supports horizontal or vertical divider as seen in examples.
    if all(row[sep] == grid[0][sep] for row in grid):
        rows = len(grid)
        # First pair: divider 2, left mask 9, right panel 6; output exactly the mask.
        if grid[0][sep] == 2:
            return [[3 if grid[r][c] == 9 else 8 for c in range(sep)] for r in range(rows)]
    # Horizontal divider case: top panel's 7s are foreground; lower panel establishes 7 background.
    div = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    if grid[div][0] == 5:
        return [[3 if v == 7 else 7 for v in row] for row in grid[:div]]
    # General vertical panels: foreground markers in the first panel map to 3.
    return [[3 if v not in (grid[0][0], grid[0][sep]) else 8 for v in row[:sep]] for row in grid]
'''
print(write_file(p,s))

    return [[3 if grid[r][c] == grid[divr+1+r][c] else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(height)]
